title: Design System: Lotp's Blog — Facing Pages

paper.note: The page. Deliberately cool, not cream.

graphite-plate.note: The one dark surface in either edition: code.

ink-muted.note: Secondary chrome. Was #6d747a (4.27:1) until the craft floor raised it.

brick.note: Reserved ink: the record or technique the reader is on. Was #c0492f (4.46:1).

night-paper.note: The same page printed on slate; accents dim with the paper so ratios hold.

label.purpose: Short tracked capitals for apparatus: Contents, Index of techniques, named states.

folio.purpose: Dates, counts, pagination position, year spine. Tabular figures.

body.purpose: Article prose. 57ch measure ≈ 75 characters per line.

body-cjk.purpose: Songti prose, PingFang headings — the Chinese edition is typeset, not translated.

motion.name: step
motion.purpose: Every state change is one short whole step.

motion.name: pair-open
motion.purpose: The one authored interaction: a paired ledger row opens its facing half.

motion.name: no-scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: Removed on purpose: opacity animation made ledger dates read at 1.0–1.3:1 contrast mid-scroll.

breakpoints.name: spread-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: The index plan stops being a column and travels with the ledger as a sticky bar.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Rows collapse; a paired twin prints under its own title; the running head wraps but keeps its control order.

measures.name: reading
measures.note: ≈75 characters per line at 17px. Was 68ch, which measured ~99 characters.

components.name: Ledger row (paired)
components.description: One date, two languages, one gutter rule.

components.name: Language switch
components.description: Appears only where a translation twin exists.

components.name: Code plate
components.description: The one dark surface; scrolls inside itself so a wide ASCII diagram never widens the page.

components.name: Page turns
components.description: Named turns and a position, never anonymous arrows.
